desc: Ideation: reduction to min over column masks S of Σ cnt[m]·g(m XOR S) with g(v)=min(popcount v, W−popcount v); XOR-convolution via WHT; overflow analysis (int64 safe).
Write the complete solution program (parsing + cnt via bincount + g weight vector + numpy int64 WHT + f = WHT(WHT(cnt)*WHT(g))>>W + print min).

Validate: sample 1 verified by hand (mask S=1 gives 2), sample 2 trivially 0 (all rows 1111 → g=0), sample 3 verified by hand (mask S=11001 gives sum 13, no smaller found among tested masks) — matches expected outputs.
Edge cases: W=1 → g=[0,0] → answer 0; H=1 works; bincount uses minlength=2^W so array size fixed; dtypes explicitly int64; division by 2^W exact via integer //.
Performance: O(H) parsing with int(bytes,2) (~2·10^5 conversions) plus three numpy WHTs of size 2^18 (O(2^18·18) butterflies, ~2 MB arrays) — well within limits.
